name: Sarah Johnson
title: Senior Software Engineer at Google
story: After completing a 12-week coding bootcamp, I landed my first junior role at a startup. The transition wasn't easy, but with dedication, continuous learning, and strong mentorship, I progressed to senior engineer in just a few years.

name: Michael Chen
title: Data Scientist at Meta
story: Coming from a mechanical engineering background, I transitioned into data science through online courses and Kaggle competitions. Persistence and mentoring helped me break into big tech.

name: Ava Martinez
title: Product Manager at Amazon
story: Starting as a customer support rep, I slowly transitioned into product by shadowing PMs, taking ownership of small features, and earning trust. Formal PM training and mentors accelerated my growth.

name: David Kim
title: AI Research Engineer at NVIDIA
story: With no formal CS education, I self-studied deep learning, contributed to open-source, and built strong research portfolios. My breakthrough came after publishing my first paper.

name: Johanna Patel
title: UX Designer at Microsoft
story: I transitioned from graphic design to UX through a bootcamp, freelance projects, and building a strong portfolio. Consistent learning, design critiques, and mentorship shaped my path.
